tfc_weight_bar.message.cart_refused: %1$s won't pull this cart: load %2$s, limit %3$s. Take some cargo out.
tfc_weight_bar.message.cart_refused_larg: %1$s won't pull this cart: %2$s slots hold large items, limit %3$s. Take some out.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.title: TFC Weight Bar
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.weight_disp: HUD bar: a bar above the food or health bar. Text: a message above the hotbar every 10 seconds. Off: neither, and item tooltips still show weights. A server can set this for every player.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.bar_positio: Above food: over the TFC food and thirst bars. Above health: over the health bar, and over the armour bar while that shows. A server can set this for every player.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.show_bar_nu: Show the weight on the bar as numbers, such as 720/1000. A server can set this for every player.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.show_cart_b: A second bar over the weight bar with the load of the cart you pull, with TFC Astikor Carts or Pull Cart. A server can set this for every player.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.forced_by_s: This server sets it for every player
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.enable_cart: An animal lets go of a cart loaded past its limit and tells the players around, and with Pull Cart a player pulling such a cart on foot is burdened. With TFC Astikor Carts the limit is that mod's overburdenedThreshold, and its own debuffs stay either way.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.pull_cart_m: With Pull Cart: the weight a cart's chest can hold before the cart is overloaded, counted as in a player's inventory.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.count_cart_: With TFC Astikor Carts: a player sitting on a cart adds to its load, their body weighed as that mod weighs a passenger and what they carry weighed as cargo. Such a player also sees the cart bar.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.large_item_: The smallest TFC size of item that counts as large for the slot limits below.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.astikor_max: TFC Astikor Carts large item slots
With TFC Astikor Carts: how many slots of a cart may hold large items before the cart is overloaded, whatever its load. 0 sets no such limit.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.pull_cart_m: With Pull Cart: how many slots of a cart's chest may hold large items before the cart is overloaded, whatever its load. 0 sets no such limit.
tfc_weight_bar.configuration.force_cart_: Shows or hides every player's cart bar. Player's choice leaves it to each player.
